tasks.title: Keep equipment identity text and stat tokens readable in constrained cards
tasks.body:
Goal:
Keep equipment identities and stat tokens readable at constrained card widths.

Current behavior:
A current automated433-case pass remains unaccepted after screenshot review found glyph-wide identity text and vertical stat labels in enlarged-phone cards. The fixed artwork/text grid reserves artwork before allowing text to use a full row. Nested preset cards reduce the remaining column further.

Desired behavior:
Stack or wrap artwork and copy when the available width cannot hold both. Keep complete stat tokens together while allowing the token group to wrap. Retain ordinary long-ID wrapping and complete displayed values.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-game-names-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-equipment-reflow-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
Scope identity/stat changes to Equipment. Preserve artwork, full names, numeric values and explicit item/preset actions. No smaller text, hidden overflow, changed optimizer decisions or provider mutation. The existing count-summary task only covers RenderImageCountChip and remains independent; the search/discovery task also remains unchanged. Local synthetic build/test authorization applies. Physical devices and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
Keep original full screenshots as the failing regression. Add ordinary-word width and unbroken stat-token assertions to real Razor fixtures and the native journey, alongside normal geometry, contrast, focus and disabled states. Use the entire required matrix.
